definitions.explanation: The transfer of heat through a material by direct contact between molecules, without bulk movement of the material itself. One of the three main modes of heat transfer, alongside convection and radiation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{金属|きんぞく}→金属：02645_kinzoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{導熱|どうねつ}{性|せい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
{導熱|どうねつ}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{断熱材|だんねつざい}→断熱材：08079_dannetsuzai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{適|てき}している→適する：02297_tekisuru⟧。
examples.english: Materials with low thermal conductivity are suitable for insulation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じた→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧{導熱|どうねつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{省|しょう}エネルギー→省エネルギー：29550_shouenerugii⟧⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な⟦ポイント→ポイント：11283_pointo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Reducing heat conduction through building walls is an important point in the design of energy-efficient houses.

notes:
A compound of {導|どう} (conduct/guide) and ⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧ (heat). Describes the physical process by which heat moves through a material from a region of higher temperature to one of lower temperature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {導熱|どうねつ}{性|せい}: thermal conductivity
- {導熱|どうねつ}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧: thermal conductivity coefficient
- {導熱|どうねつ}⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧: heat-conducting material

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{熱伝導|ねつでんどう}→熱伝導：23583_netsudendou⟧: heat conduction (more common term, same meaning)
- {伝熱|でんねつ}: heat transfer (broader term including conduction, convection, and radiation)
- {対流|たいりゅう}: convection (heat transfer through fluid movement)
- ⟦{放射|ほうしゃ}→放射：16334_housha⟧: radiation (heat transfer through electromagnetic waves)
